decks.notes: The focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to use Gatekeeper of Malakir as the commander to maintain control over the game by disrupting opponent's strategies and removing threats. By utilizing a variety of removal spells, board wipes, and hand disruption cards, this deck aims to keep the opponent on the backfoot and slowly grind out a victory. The goal is to outlast the opponent through attrition and resource management, ultimately overwhelming them with the powerful capabilities of the mono black control archetype.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures in order to quickly reduce their life total to zero. By utilizing a combination of white and green creatures, this Commander Pauper deck aims to establish early board presence and maintain pressure throughout the game. With the use of efficient creatures and combat tricks, this deck is designed to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent, ultimately leading to victory through consistent and relentless aggression.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize Lotleth Troll as the commander to create an aggressive playstyle in a Pauper 1 vs 1 format. The deck is built around a Black/Green aggro archetype, aiming to quickly overwhelm opponents with fast and efficient creatures. By utilizing the commander's abilities and synergizing with the rest of the cards in the deck, the goal is to establish board presence early on and maintain pressure on the opponent throughout the game.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain control over the game by using a combination of blue and black spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy, counter threats, and control the board. Obyra, Dreaming Duelist serves as the commander that complements the control strategy with its abilities. The deck is designed to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent, ultimately leading to a victory through strategic decision-making and resource management.
